selection_reason: TA-19 is the corrected primary selection because the source facts establish a detour for one travel direction: opposing traffic is prohibited and sent via other roads while the ego-direction lane remains open. This is not a whole-road closure, so TA-8 and TA-20 are not primary. TA-7 was reviewed but depicts a same-road diversion rather than the confirmed off-site detour. TA-9 requires an overlapping-route situation that is not established. TA-18 concerns a minor-street lane closure with possible self-regulation and does not match the confirmed full directional prohibition. TA-21 through TA-25 concern specific lane-closure or intersection geometries; TA-21 through TA-23 and TA-25 are not established, and TA-24 cannot be selected as primary because near-side/far-side geometry is unresolved. TA-26 and TA-27 concern work located in or at a particular part of the intersection, which is not established. TA-28 and TA-29 concern pedestrian facilities; TA-47 through TA-51 concern bicycle or shared-use-path facilities; and TA-52 through TA-54 concern circular intersections, none of which is established. Missing illustrated devices are deferred to later device-adequacy and augmentation review and do not defeat the TA-19 operation-level selection.
